title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode6 My Reason for Helping

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, anyone else feel like we went the wrong way? This trail's just been getting rougher and rougher...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You too? I thought the same thing since we haven't gotten even a glimpse of the parking lot yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this feels strange. We went down the beginner route just like the sign back there said...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe we should go back and retrace our steps...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should. We turned there and came from... Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which way did we come from again...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Didn't we come from the left?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do we do? We've taken so many turns, we've forgotten where we came from...!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, don't say that! It's not a big mountain or anything, so I'm sure we'll find our way back, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right! We can just check on our phones to see where we are too...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Duh! Wow, I was really worried there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no! What else can we do...?!
What if you waved your phone around in the air?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe I am getting something...
If I just go over here and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
I didn't see it drop off there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's just a part of hiking.
I'm gonna pull you up, so come a little closer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi, wait! This rock under my foot's about to...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, I brought some candy with me. Would you like a piece?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Did you hear someone scream just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? There are plenty of wild animals around here. Someone could've just come across one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it looks like it's about to start raining too, Nene. We may want to find some shelter before it's too late...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Those definitely look like rain clouds...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm getting a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I scraped my knee a little, but I should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm okay too, but my clothes got pretty dirty...
Ugh...This stuff better wash out...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I haven't gotten this muddy since the last time I was on a variety show...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How can you say something like that right now?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, we're fine!
We just slipped and fell is all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'll just have to climb our way back up! Let's go, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get out of here and get cleaned up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! Mizuki! We're gonna try climbing back up! Can you pull us up when we get close?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be able to!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to put my legs to the test! Those shows all prepared me for something like this!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can use this rock to jump up and... Whoa...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No good. The moss is too slippery...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I can't give up here. I wouldn't be able to call myself an idol if I did! We're getting out of here!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you okay?! Are you hurt?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm fine...
But I can't get back up at all. I feel like a disgrace as an idol...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What does being an idol have to do with this...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They're having quite a bit of trouble...
It feels like they're just out of our reach. Maybe we can pull them up if we go out a little further...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe, but if they slip while you're doing that, you'd fall down there with them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is there anything else we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku, I can try looking for a place where I get a signal and call for help!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena! Airi!
This might take a while, but try to hang on, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: But the trail!! What if you get lost when you're by yourself...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be fine! I promise to be right back with help!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku, can you wait with them here? We need to make sure nothing happens to them while we try to get help...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hm? Rain? But it was sunny a second ago...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, it's really starting to come down... If I don't get help soon, Ena and Airi are gonna be in trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And no signal yet, but I think I'm getting close... I just gotta keep trying...!!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*... They're ruined...
I really liked this outfit too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Seriously, what am I doing?
Getting all muddy in a place like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I want to keep hanging out with everyone, does that mean I have to tell them...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want things to stay like this next year and the year after, but a part of me still thinks it's pointless...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know that...
I get it, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <After we saw those cherry blossoms together, did something happen? You seem a little different, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If there's something bothering you, Mizuki, I think you should talk to Ena about it. I'm sure she can help you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For now, I need to keep going...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can just buy new clothes to replace these. What happens next year or the year after doesn't matter right now either...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I have to find a way to save Ena and Airi...!)
We got down sooner than I expected.
Yeah. It's a good thing that we saw it coming too. We should be able to keep dry here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(People...? Hey, a rest area...!
Thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really need your help!!
My friends fell off a ledge...!
